title: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires on the Claude API Nov 30, 2026; use claude-sonnet-5-5

review.summary:
The model-string swap covers every `claude-sonnet-4-5` literal in the .js files shown. That includes the request bodies in api/*, demo/*, scripts/*, src/rhetorical.js and the `model` metadata written to Redis. The Haiku constant in api/umang-chunk.js is correctly left alone. I could not confirm `claude-sonnet-5-5` from memory, but the quoted deprecation table names it as the replacement. Confirm it against the models list or SDK types before merge.

The 'verified' grade overstates what was proven. The only check is a new grep test (test/model.test.js). It never parses or runs any file and makes no live API call. It only scans .js files, and it also enforces unrelated rules (it bans `tool_choice` and `type: 'disabled'`, and requires at least 10 files) that the migration doesn't call for.

Pre-existing: api/klh-script.js contains unresolved merge-conflict markers (<<<<<<< HEAD / ======= / >>>>>>> db8f43e). That file cannot load as a module today, and this PR edits a line inside the conflicted block without resolving it.

concerns.issue: The diff edits the cacheSet `model` field (~line 213), which sits inside an unresolved `>>>>>>> db8f43e` conflict block. The file is syntactically invalid before and after the change, so this endpoint stays broken. The grep test passes anyway, so the grade hides that the endpoint was never exercised.

The test is a pure string grep. It does not import or syntax-check any file, does not call the API, and does not confirm that `claude-sonnet-5-5` is accepted by the Messages API with anthropic-version 2023-06-01. It also bans `tool_choice` and `type:'disabled'` and sets an arbitrary `n<10` threshold. None of that is required by the retirement, and it will fail future legitimate code.

Only `.js` files are scanned. Any reference to `claude-sonnet-4-5` in .html, .ts, .mjs, .json, vercel config or env files would be missed. The match agent listed no call sites, so coverage outside .js is unverified.

This path asks the model for a bare JSON object and presumably parses it. A newer model may format output differently (e.g. markdown fences), and nothing tests the parse. The same applies to the Devanagari-only and word-count prompts in the api/* and scripts/* files, which are product behaviour that should be spot-checked.

Existing Redis entries generated by 4-5 are still served as Tier 1. Only new write-backs carry the new `model` tag, so the cache will hold mixed provenance. That is acceptable, but note it if anything reads the `model` field.

checkFirst: Confirm `claude-sonnet-5-5` is a valid model ID on the Messages API (models endpoint or @anthropic-ai/sdk types) by making one real request from api/ekyc-chunk.js or src/rhetorical.js.
Resolve the merge-conflict markers in api/klh-script.js and run `node --check` on every touched file.
Grep the whole repo, not just .js files, for `sonnet-4-5`.
Decide whether to keep the unrelated `tool_choice`/`disabled` bans and the n>=10 rule in test/model.test.js; downgrade the grade to needs-review until a live call passes.

review.summary: The diff swaps every visible `claude-sonnet-4-5` call and cache-metadata label for `claude-sonnet-5-5`. That covers the raw-fetch endpoints (api/ekyc-chunk.js, api/journey-chunk.js, api/klh-script.js, and api/umang-chunk.js via the SONNET constant, which also drives its cache metadata), the SDK calls (demo/server.js, demo/server_old.js, src/rhetorical.js) and the five seeding scripts. The code used the undated alias rather than the dated `-20250929` ID in the notice; the alias resolves to that snapshot, so these call sites are affected and the swap is warranted. I can't confirm `claude-sonnet-5-5` from memory. The quoted deprecation table names it as the replacement; check the models overview page and that the ID resolves on this account before merging. The HAIKU constant (`claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`) is correctly left alone. No checks ran, so nothing proves the new model answers or keeps the output contracts (Devanagari-only prose; bare JSON in rhetorical.js). The needs-review grade fits that. Pre-existing and not caused by this PR: api/klh-script.js contains unresolved merge-conflict markers (<<<<<<< HEAD / ======= / >>>>>>> db8f43e) and will not parse. The diff's second edit in that file sits inside the incoming side of the conflict, so whoever resolves it must keep the new model string.

concerns.issue: This prompt demands 'a single JSON object. No markdown.' and the caller presumably JSON.parses the reply. A newer model generation may wrap output in fences or add preamble differently than sonnet-4-5 did. No check exercises this path, so a parse failure would only show up live.

The live Tier-2 output is user-facing Hindi with strict Devanagari-only and word-count rules. The model change can alter script compliance and length; nothing was sampled. Tier-1 cached answers (labelled sonnet-4-5) will now sit beside sonnet-5-5 live answers in the tier-compare demo.

The cached entries' `model` metadata label changes, and existing Redis entries stay tagged `claude-sonnet-4-5`. Harmless unless something reads `model` to filter or invalidate the cache; worth a grep to confirm nothing does.
The match agent listed no call sites, so coverage of the change rests on this diff alone. Model IDs in HTML/front-end files, env defaults, README or vercel config would not be caught.

Run `grep -rn 'sonnet-4' .` across the whole repo, including HTML, JSON, env and docs, to make sure no call site was missed.
Exercise src/rhetorical.js once against the new model and confirm the reply still parses as bare JSON.
Resolve the pre-existing merge conflict in api/klh-script.js, keeping the `claude-sonnet-5-5` value in the write-back block.
